sources.title: Commissioning results from the Robo-AO-2 facility for rapid visible and near-infrared AO imaging
sources.evidence: Instrument description; NGS optical path and internal MEMS identity.
sources.scope: NGS hardware. The 355 nm QE and laser readout/loop measurements are not NGS measurements.

sources.title: Simulation results for Robo-AO-2 using HAPA: a wavefront sensing technique for improving the adaptive optics correction of fainter stars
locators: Section 3.1, Tables 5 and 6; Table 7 NGS-only rows; Section 2.1 for inherited spectral assumptions
sources.evidence: Published as-built simulation inputs, not measured closed-loop NGS telemetry.
sources.scope: Select NGS-only. Do not import the LGS uplink gain, hybrid reconstructor or LGS photon return.

sources.title: Robo-AO-2: entering the era of automated science operations, hybrid wavefront sensing, and adaptive secondary integration
sources.evidence: 16x16 NGS operation enabled in mid-2025; separate NGS and LGS systems.
sources.scope: Use the documented internal-MEMS era. Planned tip-tilt upgrade and ASM integration are not assumed complete.

sources.title: Continuous Deformable Mirror Standard Models
locators: 492-3.5 row; physical stroke, wavefront stroke, pitch and coupling columns
sources.evidence: Manufacturer nominal model specifications, not the installed mirror calibration.
sources.scope: Centred usable stroke and Gaussian influences require additional assumptions.

research_questions.question: Which NGS mode actually operated?
research_questions.answer: 16x16 internal MEMS, documented in S3; exact current servo settings remain unverified.

research_questions.question: Are public noise and atmosphere numbers measured hardware settings?
research_questions.answer: S2 supplies simulation inputs. They remain literature assumptions even when called as-built.

research_questions.question: Can surface stroke directly become an OPD half-limit?
research_questions.answer: Only after one reflection factor and a centred-bias assumption; installed reserve remains unknown.

research_questions.question: Can the existing schema represent every instrument subsystem?
research_questions.answer: It lacks an independent tip-tilt loop and measured DM maps. Camera loading is packaged-preset-only.
